name: Frustum-Box Containment Test
definition: Determines if an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) is fully contained within a view frustum defined by a projection * view matrix. Used to cull volume rendering geometry when it falls outside the camera's view.
summary: Frustum-Box Containment Test determines if an axis-aligned bounding box is fully contained within a view frustum by testing mutual containment rather than just box outside frustum.
